environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules. The ALB performs TLS termination only. The application serves static files directly from the uploads directory via express.static. No HSM_VERIFY_ENDPOINT is configured (environment variable unset). The EC2 instance has a public security group allowing inbound on port 443. No additional middleware or reverse proxy content inspection is configured.

config.load_balancer: ALB with default HTTPS listener, no WAF attached
